passive.name: Death in Lavender
passive.description: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions. She also gains temporary bonus attack speed after using an ability.

spells.name: Void Surge
spells.description: Bel'Veth dashes, dealing physical damage to enemies she passes through. Each direction has an unique Cooldown of seconds that scales down based on her Attack Speed.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BaseDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Above and Below
spells.description: Bel'Veth slams her tail, dealing magic damage, Knocking Up foes for seconds, and Slowing them by % for seconds. If a champion is hit, this refreshes the Cooldown of Void Surge in that direction.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Royal Maelstrom
spells.description: Bel'Veth channels and slashes around herself, gaining % Damage Reduction, Life Steal, and Attacking times over seconds with the number of Attacks increasing based on her Attack Speed. Each Attack strikes the lowest-health enemy, dealing to physical damage based on the target's missing Health. Using another Ability or Recasting ends this Ability early.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamagePerStrike was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Endless Banquet
spells.description: Passive: Attacks deal an additional true damage, stacking infinitely. Takedowns against champions and epic monsters leave behind a piece of Void Coral. Active: Bel'Veth consumes a Void Coral, gaining Lavender stack and activating her true form. Void Coral from void epic monsters causes minions that die nearby to become Void Remora. While casting, Bel'Veth Slows nearby enemies before exploding, dealing + % missing-Health true damage. In her true form, Bel'Veth gains max Health, Attack range, % Total Attack Speed, and Void Surge can pass through walls. True form lasts seconds, increased to seconds at Lavender stacks. At Lavender stacks, true form lasts until death.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation FinalOnHitDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
